tournament.title: IMC Over 40s World Cup 2026
tournament.overview: The inaugural IMC Over 40s World Cup will be held in Guyana in October 2026, bringing together top cricketing nations for a celebration of masters cricket.

news.title: England Squad Arrives in Guyana
news.summary: The England Over 40s squad has landed in Guyana, full of anticipation for the upcoming World Cup. Final preparations are underway.

news.title: Captain's Press Conference Ahead of Tournament
news.summary: England Captain addresses the media, expressing confidence in the team's chances and highlighting the team's rigorous training regimen.
